vo_open.text: This quiet lake killed seventeen hundred and forty-six people.

vo.text: Lake Nyos sits in the crater of an old volcano.
vo.cap: Lake Nyos sits in an *old volcano.*

vo.text: Deep down, its water was full of carbon dioxide.
On August twenty-first, 1986, it all came up at once.
vo.cap: *August 21, 1986:* it all came up at once.

vo.text: A column of foam, a hundred meters high.
vo.cap: A column of foam *100 meters* high.

vo.text: Up to three hundred thousand tons of gas. Heavier than air, it rolled downhill.
vo.cap: Up to *300,000 tons* of gas. Heavier than air, it *rolled downhill.*

vo.text: It reached villages up to twenty-five kilometers away.
vo.cap: It reached villages up to *25 km* away.

vo.text: Nearly everyone in the closest village suffocated.
vo.cap: Nearly everyone in the closest village *suffocated.*

vo.text: Seventeen forty-six people. Thirty-five hundred animals.
And the blue lake had turned deep red.
vo.cap: And the blue lake turned *deep red.*

vo.text: Since 2001, pipes let the gas escape from the bottom, so it can't build up again.
vo.cap: Since *2001,* pipes vent the gas... so it can't build up again.
